messages:
Eli: Quick sync — Orion Finance POC goes live tomorrow 09:00 ET. They want a short one-pager: reserved GPU count, AZ split option, autoscale behavior for 2-8m spikes, preheat runbook, and licensing note for quantized variants.
Noor: Do we have their traffic sketch?
Eli: SRE sent: steady 200 qps embeddings + 80 qps gen; two daily spikes to ~1.5k qps lasting ~3-6 minutes. 95p targets: embeddings <=140ms, gen <=250ms. Business-hours SLA Mon-Fri.
Sam: Ballpark reserved sizing: steady + 25% headroom -> round to 4 reserved A100-eq GPUs. Autoscale to 8 for spikes with burst credits.
Priya: AZ spread: recommend symmetric 2+2 for real failover. If budget constrained, document 3+1 (primary heavy) with degraded tail on failover.
Noor: Preheat runbook (short for questionnaire): schedule preheat 30m before peak; run KV replay at 30% peak for 5m; run synthetic QPS soak at 50% for 5m; verify KV hit-rate >= 85%; if not ready, enable burst credits and notify Redwood oncall.
Sam: Pasteable autoscale policy for ops:```json
{ "autoscale": { "min_reserved_gpus": "4", "max_gpus": "8", "scale_step": "1", "cooldown_s": "180", "preheat_window_mins": "30", "burst_credit_pool": "enabled", "burst_qps_cap": "2000" }}
```
Priya: Note cooldown 180s tuned to avoid oscillation on short spikes. Also enforce per-customer burst cap to avoid noisy neighbors.
Noor: Licensing: quantized runtime included in platform fee; legal wants explicit contract line: "Redwood's quantized inference runtime is provided under platform services; no separate runtime license applies."
Eli: Pricing ask: they want blended reserved + burst quote. Presales guidance: reserved = monthly commit rate; burst credits sold as hourly blocks at discounted incremental rate; cross-AZ reserved adds a small infra surcharge. Sam — can you add numbers to the one-pager?
Sam: Yes, I'll attach a sample pricing table after the draft.
Priya: Observability checklist to include in questionnaire: per-route token counts, 95/99/99.9 latency percentiles, KV hit-rate, preheat job logs, and audit trail for preheat triggers. All surfaced in Console and via API; metrics aggregated with PII redaction.
ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC — schedule preheat outside this window. :warning:
Eli: Good catch. We'll move preheat earlier. Action items: (1) I'll draft one-pager with sizing rationale, AZ split notes, autoscale snippet, preheat runbook, pricing bullets, and license line; (2) Sam to add pricing numbers; (3) Priya to prepare KV warmup script + small load-gen sample; (4) Noor to update questionnaire text. Aim to send to Orion Finance within 3 hours. :rocket:
